observations: White game console with a vertical split design, characteristic of the PlayStation 5 Slim model.
One photo shows the console with a black and white DualSense controller.
The console is shown from the side in photo 0 and from the front in photo 1.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI ABIODUN JAMES' is visible across both images.
The console is resting on a wooden surface with a framed picture in the background.

claims.evidence: The photos show a clean exterior, but internal cleanliness and the presence of dust or fungus are not visible.
The vertical split design is the signature of the PS5 Slim model.
A DualSense controller is visible in both photos.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a faulty HDMI port.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen and a clear shot of the HDMI port.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate menus or a screenshot of a controller test utility.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A screenshot of the console's system information screen showing the PSN status.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen.
Video of the controller being used to navigate the system menu.
Screenshot of the system information screen showing the PSN status.
Close-up photo of the HDMI port to check for damage.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Sony PlayStation 5 Slim with a controller. It can be priced at its worst-case functional state until proof of operation and PSN status is provided.
